description.value: A wilderness beach campsite on the Juan de Fuca Marine Trail, reached by a roughly 2.5 km hike through old-growth coastal forest to a dramatic ocean beach with a sea cave and waterfall; no vehicle or bike access, fee required, and a short summer season.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a backcountry campsite on the Juan de Fuca Marine Trail; the website confirms the park exists and describes the trail as a rugged 47 km backcountry route for experienced hikers, with open fires and tents permitted (corroborating OSM tags). However, the website covers Juan de Fuca Provincial Park as a whole rather than Mystic Beach Campsite specifically, so no campsite-level amenity details (water, shelter, food storage, reservations) can be confirmed. The campsite is accessible only by foot trail from the trailhead, not by bicycle.
concerns: Website covers Juan de Fuca Provincial Park as a whole, not Mystic Beach Campsite specifically — no campsite-level amenity details can be verified from the available content.
Campsite is backcountry only and accessible solely via hiking trail, not by bicycle.
No phone number or street address present in OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Mystic Beach is a backcountry campsite accessible only by foot trail and not directly rideable to by bicycle; its inclusion depends on whether the directory covers hike-in wilderness sites near cycle-touring routes on southern Vancouver Island.

wow_evidence: Juan de Fuca Marine Trail... dramatic ocean beach with a sea cave and waterfall; no vehicle or bike access
